svg.title: Bahdanau decoder unrolled across two output timesteps with all inputs shown
svg.desc: At each decoding step, the decoder cell takes the previous output token, the previous decoder hidden state, and a freshly computed context vector derived from attention over all encoder states, producing a new hidden state and predicted word that both feed into the next timestep, repeating for as many steps as there are output words.
svg.text: Same decoder weights reused at every step — each step computes its own fresh c_t
